moduleTitle: Module 1. Foundations, Membranes and Cell Signaling
topicSummary: Quantitative Skills for Physiology. 4 competencies, week 1.

competencies.name: Units and unit conversion
competencies.can: Convert among the units used in physiology including molarity, osmolarity, milliequivalents, mmHg, liters per minute, and percent solutions.

competencies.name: Graphing and data interpretation
competencies.can: Construct a labeled graph with the independent variable on the x axis, and read slope, direction, and trend from a physiological data set.

competencies.name: Experimental design and controls
competencies.can: Identify the hypothesis, independent variable, dependent variable, and control condition in a physiology experiment and state what the control rules out.

competencies.name: Measurement error and variability
competencies.can: Distinguish random from systematic error and explain why physiological measurements are repeated and averaged.
